description: Set — or clear — the BRAND of many products in one call, the way the CRM's product list bar does it. scope names the products: a list of ids (at most 100, from search_products), a model (every colour and size of it) or a category (add includeSubcategories to take the ones under it); an open filter is not accepted. A brand belongs to the model, so for a product in a model the model changes and every article of it follows — articles outside the ones named are counted in expandedByModel, never hidden. brandId comes from list_brands or create_brand (null clears the brand). Products that already have the brand are skipped. A brand called Unbranded needs no special handling: Amazon listings send it as Generic. Saved in the CRM; a live Amazon offer keeps its brand until it is updated there. Idempotent. Returns { affected, skipped, expandedByModel } and the workspace. Use update_product to change one product.

brandId.description: The brand id from list_brands, or null to remove the brand.

scope.description: Which products: { kind: 'ids', ids: [...] }, { kind: 'model', id } or { kind: 'category', id, includeSubcategories? }.

name: bulk_set_product_brand
title: Set the brand of many products
